title: AC1032 TABLECONTENT bounded raw-only shell recovery

source.provenance: Tracked external ACadSharp sample; used read-only, not copied into this repository.

authority.oda: ODA v5.4.1 §2 requires R2007+ object Unicode strings in the detached string stream; §20.4.99 describes TABLECONTENT value strings as TV. The peer's body-byte-count interpretation remains unreconciled.
authority.implementationPolicy: Do not change TABLECONTENT field parsing or infer semantic values. Preserve only the common shell and exact raw frame when the typed parser fails and RawObjectShell validates.

typedFailureTrace.interpretation: The ordinary parser's cursor reaches code 0x5 at its interpreted first cell-attribute slot. The subsequent body/string span probe shows that this interpretation is likely displaced; see handleAndBodySpanRecheck. It does not establish a producer/spec role violation or qualify typed payload or output.
typedFailureTrace.codeChange: Added debug-only boundary diagnostics in src/drw_entities.cpp; no parser interpretation or output behavior changed.

exactDetachedStringStream.interpretation: The previously reported 17-bit pre-handle gap is exactly the raw 16-bit string-size word plus the final string-present bit. The candidate cursor is at the ODA-defined string-data end.

handleAndBodySpanRecheck.interpretation: A debug-only alternate parse treats the type-4 value as a BL byte-counted body string, then reads unit 0, zero attributes, content-format fields and the observed code-0x5 text-style handle. Both records reach the exact body boundary, and the candidate string cursors equal the exact R2007+ detached-stream ends: the 14,076/13,368-bit spans match the footer size words and the following 17 bits are the size word plus string-present bit. The earlier failed trailing-TV probe had treated that footer as text. Each final unconsumed handle bit is exactly the padding needed to align the handle stream to a byte boundary, consistent with ODA v5.4.1 §20.1. The candidate remains semantically incomplete and conflicts with ODA v5.4.1 §§2 and 20.4.99; this does not independently establish its schema.
handleAndBodySpanRecheck.implementationPolicy: Keep the production interpretation, raw-only fallback and strict-output refusal unchanged. Resolve the candidate's complete string/handle framing and its conflict with the authoritative ODA text before adopting it.

peerParserRecheck.interpretation: These malformed-looking nested values and premature geometry boundaries show that this local peer build is also desynchronized on the same sample. It is not independent field/span evidence and cannot resolve the ODA role mismatch.
peerParserRecheck.fixturePolicy: Input is the existing external ACadSharp sample; no file was copied into this repository.

ACadSharp.observation: TABLECONTENT string values route through readStringCadValue: BL byte count followed by bytes; the source comment says this also seems valid for string values. The caller then reads unit, format TV and display TV. The comment is a reader observation, not normative evidence.

LibreDWG.observation: TABLE_value_fields uses FIELD_T for type 4 and suppresses the payload when flags & 3 is nonzero; TABLECONTENTs_fields declares the ATTDEF field with handle code 5. These assumptions differ from the ACadSharp body-byte-count route and from ODA v5.4.1's bit-0 payload suppression and soft-pointer ATTDEF role. LibreDWG 0.14 leaves the two physical TABLECONTENT frames unknown, so these macros do not provide a successful independent parse.

peerSourceCodeReview.independenceLimit: The ACadSharp-inspired dwgTs parser is not a separate implementation family. Neither the inspected source comments nor an unsupported LibreDWG object classification can adjudicate the physical source.

implementation.behavior: For only AC1032 TABLECONTENT / AcDbTableContent, a failed typed-body parse may publish raw-only after an independent RawObjectShell validates the common header and handle tail. The raw carrier has typedPayloadValidated=false and no TableContent callback is sent. An invalid shell remains failed. Strict output remains blocked by the raw-object/context replay gates.

stringFooterBoundaryDiagnostic.result: Both AC1032 candidate cursors equal the exact detached string-stream end calculated from the R2007+ footer. The low-size word matches the string-data span, high-size word is zero, and the presence bit is one. Each one-bit handle tail exactly aligns the decoded handle stream to the next byte boundary as specified by ODA §20.1; candidate semanticComplete remains false.
stringFooterBoundaryDiagnostic.scope: Debug-only diagnostics and source-bound span accounting; no parser interpretation, typed publication, output eligibility or support claim changed.

scopeLimit: This closes raw frame publication for the two current AC1032 TABLECONTENT objects only. The debug-only body-byte-count candidate reaches exact body, detached-string, and byte-aligned handle-stream boundaries, but remains in conflict with ODA v5.4.1 §§2 and 20.4.99 and its typed projection is semantically incomplete. The acadrust parser is ACadSharp-derived and its fixture was unavailable locally; this lead is closed unless the exact producer bytes become available through an already authorized source. No output support, other version/producer qualification, or native TABLE rendering is established.
